subject: gk
question: Which of the following is NOT responsible for hypertension?

options.text: Excess weight and lack of exercise
Intake of nicotine either through smoking or chewing tobacco

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Consuming less salt**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hypertension**, also known as high blood pressure, is a condition where the blood pressure in the arteries is persistently elevated.
 
• **Consuming less salt** is generally recommended to manage and reduce hypertension rather than causing it.
 
• High sodium intake is associated with higher blood pressure, so reducing salt intake can help lower blood pressure.
 
• Dietary guidelines recommend limiting sodium intake to less than **2,300 mg per day** to reduce the risk of hypertension.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Excess weight and lack of exercise**__

 __
 
• **Excess weight** can increase the risk of developing hypertension because more blood is needed to supply oxygen and nutrients to tissues, which increases pressure on artery walls.
 
• **Lack of exercise** can lead to weight gain and poor heart health, both of which are risk factors for hypertension.
 
 
 
• **Intake of nicotine either through smoking or chewing tobacco**__
 __
 
• **Nicotine** raises blood pressure and heart rate, narrows arteries, and hardens their walls, which can contribute to hypertension.
 
• Both **smoking** and **chewing tobacco** introduce nicotine into the body, which has adverse effects on cardiovascular health.
 
 
 
• **Living under stress and worry**__
 
 
• **Chronic stress** can lead to an increase in heart rate and blood pressure, contributing to hypertension.
 
• **Stressful situations** can cause temporary spikes in blood pressure, which may become chronic if stress is not managed well.
